As a Saudi citizen, I do not accept TikTok removing videos of people defending their homeland. Saudi Arabia is a red line, with a thousand red lines beneath it. I will never accept any insult, harm, or attack against my country, its people, or its government. I ask TikTok to review these removals and respect our right to express our love and defend our homeland peacefully. 🇸🇦💚

reviews.title: السعودية خط احمر
reviews.text: سيئ

Saudi Arabia does not need you This application is both discriminatory and highly inadequate. It contributes to the dissemination and provocation of animosity. The staff of this app exhibits racism and hostility towards Saudis and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. When we defend ourselves against those who insult us and our country. our comments are deleted and made public. However, the same policy is not enforced against other accounts that insult, ridicule, and disseminate false information about us through live broadcasts, clips, and comments. Instead, the offenders' comments are dismissed and ignored, and the same rules do not seem to apply to them! Voting is also restricted, erasing facts and clips that support or discuss the defense and preservation of our kingdom, history, heritage, culture, and rulers, including kings, princes, and crown prince. The uneven application of the law demonstrates sheer hypocrisy and a lack of respect for other societies and their values in your app. We do not need an app like this when there are other superior alternatives available. It is imperative that you reconsider your policies and objectives. You must act with fairness and impartiality, avoiding the incitement of hatred and the propagation of lies within societies. Your behavior is disaraceful, and you should be ashamed of yourselves.

reviews.text: Honestly, what’s going on with TikTok? Why are videos showing support for Saudi Arabia getting taken down? 🇸🇦 We’re proud of our country, and we won’t stay silent when content supporting Saudi Arabia gets removed. There’s nothing wrong with showing love and support for our homeland. TikTok needs to explain why this keeps happening and treat Saudi users fairly. Our country means a lot to us, and we won’t just accept this. 🇸🇦💚
